tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab mo yang t-ig gi dkar chag dpag bsam

ljon pa bzhugs so/ / gzod nas 'khrul pa'i dngos kun mi 'dzin pas/ /sgrib gnyis cha dang bcas pa'i dag bya kun/ /rang bzhin ma grub 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhir/ /chos sku'i rol par bltas te ngang gis 'dud/ /rnam grol mkha' la sna tshogs gsal ba'i cha/ /'gogs med chu 'dzin bsgrod byed bsir bu'i zlar/ /lam bden smra tshig bya rtsol yongs bral yang*/ /longs sku'i dgyes tshul ston la goms bzhin gus/ /sngar med gsar thob ma yin gsang ba bzhis/ /chod pa de bsal bum nang mar me bzhin/ /sku yi 'du 'bral med pa bral smin gyis/ /yon tan kun rdzogs sprul skur mos gus bsten/ /'gro kun rmongs pa'i thib bur bag med pas/ /'phyan las gdon nus blo gros mi zad mig /sbyin byed dus gsum mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs/ /ris su ma chad yongs la dad phyag 'bul/ /ma hā sendhi'i lung rtogs dam pa'i mdzod/ /blta 'dod tshig brgyud mi chad yi ge'i phyir/ /spel ba'i ngo mtshar rdo rje chos gnyis pa/ khyod las gzhan du mi dmigs yi rangs 'bul/ /gang gis bka' drin grib ma snum po la/ /las nyon tsha gdung drag po nam du'ang min/ /zhi bsil myang 'das go sar 'jug 'dod ched/ /sngar med zab pa pod bzhi'i them skas gsar/ /'gro khams rgya mtshor 'babs pa ji snyed kyi/ / chos char rgya mtshor 'bebs pa'i klu dbang ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas te ye shes rgya mtsho dang*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas du shes bya/ /des gsungs nang gi mngon pa'i yongs rtse ni/ /nye lam khyad par can gyur brtson 'grus rab/ /skye ba gcig gis rig 'dzin gral snyogs pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po snying thig las gzhan min/ /de don nyams su len dang 'dzin pa ni/ /skyes sbyongs yon tan phun tshogs skal ldan yin/ /phyogs re'i blo can khron pa'i 'phar 'gro yis/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rgya mtsho'i tshul mi phig /dga' rab rdo rje nas brtsams deng gi bar/

/gsang mdzod 'chang rnams rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gang 'dul der ston sna tshogs sprul sku las/ /tha dad ma yin ngo bo nyid du gcig /lung gi rjod byed thig pa'i rim kun yang*/ /'gal bar mi 'gro brjod bya'i gnad kyis mthun/ /lam gyi khyad par myur bul yod med de/ /'bras bu myang 'das go sar chabs cig 'babs/ /rgya bod gnyis kar mchog gsang lam 'di yis/ /grub pa'i go sar gshegs pa du ma'i phyir/ /mi bslu'i tshad ma yod pas 'khrul pa bral/ /de phyir lam 'dir mi brtson shes ldan su/ /snying thig rnam bzhi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /gdams ngag yongs bcud mar gyi gang bu 'khrungs/ /zab mo yang thig kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i/ /mkhyen dpyod dngas shel snod las bton pa bzhin/ /dri med lha lam yangs par brgya phrag gi /'od zer 'gyed pa'i nyi ma gsar 'khrungs des/ /lhun grub snang bzhi'i pad tshal bzhad pa na/ /tshe gcig grol 'dod rkang drug ci dgar rtse/ de tshul yi ge'i phyi mo par gyi 'phrul/ /gleg ba ma gnyis su byas pa'i dpe tho ni/ /dpag bsam ljon pa blo ldan rnam pad kyi/ /tshogs la sman phyir bkod pa don ldan yin/ /de la thog mar dkar chag dpag bsam ljon pa sdeb/ /bshad rgyud skor la/ (ka) lo rgyus rin po che 'od kyi phreng ba sdeb/ 10 (kha) phyag 'tshal yid bzhin nor bu sdeb/ 5 (ga) gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun sdeb/ 3 (nga) maṇḍal cho ga gling bzhi rgyan gyur sdeb/ 8 (ca) bi ma la'i bsgrub thabs sdeb/ 3 (cha) snying po ye shes bla sgrub sdeb/ 4 (ja) spros bcas dbang chog dngos grub chu bo sdeb/ 10 (nya) spros bcas ming gi rim pa sdeb/ 4 (ta) spros med dbang chog klong gsal chu ba sdeb/ 12 (tha) bum pa'i brda don sdeb/ 3 (da) shin tu spros med dbang chog ye shes chu bo sdeb/ 3 (na) rab tu spros med dbang chog byin rlabs chu bo sdeb/ 5 (pa) dam tshig gsum bkod sdeb/ 12

(pha) thun mong rin chen pra khrid sdeb/ 3 (ba) khrid yig sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sdeb/ 23 (ma) gzhi ma bcos ji bzhin du ngo sprod pa'i rim pa sdeb/ 32 (tsa) rgya mtsho ar gtad sdeb/ 4 (tsha) khyung chen gshog rdzogs sdeb/ 3 (tsha) khyung chen bsdus don sdeb/ 4 (dza) gsang ba bla med spyi babs sdeb/ 3 (wa) zab mo bcud bsdus sdeb/ 2 (zha) snying po don bsdus sdeb/ 2 (za) 'od gsal snying po sdeb/ 2 ('a) des don snying po sdeb/ 2 (ya) mthar thug don gyi snying po sdeb/ 7 (ra) gzhi lam 'bras bu gnas gsal ba sdeb/ 7 (la) rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa sdeb/ 19 (sha) zab mo pra khrid sdeb/ 9 (sa) snying po yang bcud sdeb/ 4 (ha) rig pa brtul zhugs sdeb/ 3 (a) dus kyi gsal byed sdeb/ 6 (ki) 'da' kha don gyi man ngag sdeb/ 7 (khi) btags grol snying po sdeb/ 4 (gi) zab don snying po sdeb/ 9 (ngi) tshig don snying po sdeb/ 1 (ci) gdams khrid don gyi mdo chings sdeb 4rnams so/ / ༈ pod gnyis par snyan brgyud skor la/ (chi) snyan brgyud gnad kyi mdo chings sdeb/ 4 (ji) brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin brlab sprin phung sdeb/ 3 (nyi) dgongs brgyud gsol 'debs sdeb/ 6 (ti) gsang skor dbang gi lag len gsal ba'i sgron me sdeb/ 7 (thi) mchog gsang lam khrid chen mo sdeb/ 3 (di) ye grol sor bzhag sdeb/ 5 (ni) snyan brgyud thugs kyi me long sdeb/ 7 (pi) snyan brgyud don gyi me long sdeb/ 24 (phi) lag khrid snying po sdeb/ 3 (bi) snyan brgyud kyi rgyab chos chen mo zab don gnad kyi me long sdeb/ 123(mi)bka' bsrung drag po sum sgril sdeb/ 5 (tsi) bskang gso dngos grub char 'bebs sdeb/ 21 (tshi) dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar sdeb 5 te chos sde bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sdeb grangs rnams bzhugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ rmi lam tsam gyi nyi tshe'i bde ba la/ /mi zhen gtan gyi sdug bsngal spong 'dod rnams/ /thos bsam sgoms pas rang rgyud chos mthun tu/

/mdzad na dam pa rnams kyi rjes su bsnyegs/ /de yang rtog dpyod nang bltas chos min dbang*/ /skad cig mi btang nyon mongs rag pa'i mgo / rim non blo sna thung ngus chos brgyad la/ /'dod pa chung na nyams len gnad song rtags/ /de ltar rang rgyud chos dang mi mthun na/ /yang zab gdams par 'phrad kyang mi grol bas/ /sgo gsum bag yod dran dang shes bzhin gyis/ /dal 'byor don yod mdzod ces thal mo sbyar/ /tshul 'di ngal brgyas par du bskrun pa po/ /lha sras mchog gang sngon dge'i bag chags khams/ / sad ltar chos mthun thu gas 'dod yongs rdzogs nas/ /zhabs pad brtan ca ི nga chos srid rgyas gyur cig /yul 'dir phywa bcud dpal 'byor cher rgyas nas/ /lo legs ljongs 'khrungs mi phyugs nad kun med/ /char chu dus bab btsa' sad ser gsum zhi/ /rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bde skyid 'phel gyur cig rgyal bstan ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung*/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i mtshan mar sgrogs pa'i dbyangs/ /srid gsum kun tu khyab pa'i lha'i rol mo/ /mchog gsum bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /ces zab mo yang thig pod gnyis par du bsgrubs pa'i dkar chag dpag bsam ljon pa 'di rgyal rigs shing sa la chen po lta bur 'khrungs pa legs byas yon tan gyis spa ba lha sras dam tshig rdo rje'i bka' gnang bzhin zhe chen pa shākya'i dge slong mthu stobs rnam par rgyal bas nyung ngu'i tshig gis 'dom pa don dang ldan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)zab mo yang thig gis dkar chag dpag bsam ljon pa/ -PAGE 360--PAGE 363--PAGE 359-
